verdict: Mixed result; neither file is better overall. By KL, Wrench is 4.1% closer to the FP8 model (95% CI -0.052 to -0.027), all of it on the agentic-coding windows; on general text the other quant is slightly closer. The other quant also gives the actual next token higher probability on six full-vocabulary windows (NLL 0.085 lower, 6/6). Repeated measurements were identical. KL is not task accuracy.

candidates.name: Best other public quant at this size (as of 2026-10-18)
